core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hafeez is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Guardian, preserver”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hafeez corresponds to the Arabic form حفيظ (Arabic root ح ف ظ (ḥ-f-ẓ); حفيظ (Ḥafīẓ)). Its core sense is protector, guardian, preserver. Hafeez is Arabic حفيظ (Ḥafīẓ) 'guardian, preserver' — an intensive form of the root ح ف ظ and a divine name (al-Ḥafīẓ). The word appears in the Qur'an (12:64: 'فَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَافِظًا'). The source gloss 'guardian, custodian' is correct.
